Privacy Notice

Last updated: June 9, 2026.

Kyber LLC collects information you submit through public inquiry and CodeFlow intake forms so we can respond to your request, prepare a relevant pre-call brief, and discuss a potential setup, subscription, or service relationship.

Information collected

Public forms may collect organization name, contact name, role/title, email, phone, department, current workflow notes, priority needs, and message content. Do not submit sensitive active-case records or confidential municipal records through public demo or intake forms.

Use

We use submitted information for sales follow-up, scope review, customer support, and internal operational tracking. Submitting a CodeFlow intake does not authorize SMS campaigns or outbound AI voice calls.

Sharing

Kyber does not sell public intake submissions. We may use operational vendors for CRM, hosting, payment processing, and communications where needed to provide the service.

Contact

Email harley@kyber-llc.com or call (561) 941-2565.
legal_blocks.terms.html:
Website Terms

Last updated: June 9, 2026.

The Kyber website, CodeFlow pages, and browser demo are provided for product information, scope review, and municipal setup evaluation. They are not a substitute for a signed agreement, procurement approval, security review, or department-specific implementation scope.

CodeFlow boundary

CodeFlow is AI-assisted workflow support. It organizes information, surfaces possible issue categories, flags uncertainty, and drafts review-ready case packet language for authorized human review. It supports authorized human review only and does not substitute for department review, approval, or official process.

Demo use

The public browser demo is for sanitized sample data only. Do not upload sensitive active-case records, private resident information, or confidential documents into the public demo.

Payment and service terms

Municipal setups and subscriptions are sales-assisted. Final pricing, scope, payment terms, security requirements, and access terms are governed by a signed proposal, SOW, order form, invoice, or contract.

Contact

Email harley@kyber-llc.com or call (561) 941-2565.
